newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE January wheat down in light trading.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE January wheat down in light trading.

text.p: Light volume trading hurt Sydney wheat futures on Tuesday, with the most-watched January contract falling A$3.00 a tonne.
Grains traders said that with only 10 lots traded in Tuesday's session overall, January wheat came under pressure before settling at A$188.00 a tonne.
Expectations of a softening in wheat prices when trading resumes at the Chicago Board of Trade after a holiday on Monday, also was sidelining some market players, one trader said.
If such sentiment prevails, it is unlikely that January SFE wheat will retest A$190.00 a tonne in the short-term, the trader added.
However, formidable technical support widely marked at A$180.00 a tonne should cushion any big moves on the downside, another trader said.
